dogecoin.text:
Who invested in dogecoin and at what price?

I got in a different points since December, I had to re-up because of the potential. And by potential I mean it's nostalgic symbolism. 

Dogecoin might not have inherent value but it represents troll culture and it will keep going up.
I wouldn't have the balls to do this, but then again, I wouldn't want to be in 6 figure debt if Dogecoin tanked either.
